skill.name: nano-banana
skill.description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini native image models through the inference.sh CLI.
skill.summary: Generate Gemini images through inference.sh with text prompts, image inputs, and model options.
skill.author: inference-shell

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives because they identify Markdown backticks, code fences, model identifiers, and documentation links rather than executable Ruby backticks. The real concerns are the broad Bash(infsh *) permission and the intended submission of prompts and image inputs to remote inference.sh and Gemini services. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed-tools to the specific infsh subcommands required, or require explicit confirmation before any command that reads files, writes files, or submits data remotely.
Add a clear privacy notice before running app commands, and tell users not to submit sensitive prompts, private images, or regulated data without approval.
Keep npx installation examples as manual reference steps, and warn users to review package sources before running installation commands.

content.user_title: Generate Gemini Images with Nano Banana
content.value_statement: Image work often needs fast model access without building API plumbing. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh commands for Gemini image generation and editing.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh Gemini image apps with text prompts.
Uses Gemini 3 Pro Image or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image app IDs.
Sets image count, aspect ratio, resolution, and output format options.
Passes input image URLs for image editing workflows.
Shows how to list image apps and generate sample input files.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Sends prompts and image inputs to external inference.sh and Gemini services.
Model availability, pricing, and output quality depend on the connected account.
Does not add separate content policy checks before generation.

use_cases.title: Create Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate quick concept images, style explorations, and composition tests from written prompts.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Drafts
use_cases.description: Create draft hero images, product scenes, and social visuals for review before final production.

use_cases.title: Prototype Asset Workflows
use_cases.description: Test image generation commands inside Claude, Codex, or Claude Code before adding them to a larger workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana to create a square product concept image of a matte black desk lamp on a clean white background.

prompt_templates.title: Create Multiple Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini 2.5 Flash Image to create four logo direction images for a small coffee shop with a calm modern style.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Image editing with a source URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the provided image URL as input and add a soft rainbow in the sky while keeping the landscape realistic.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a High-Resolution Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Gemini 3 Pro Image workflow for a 16:9 4K cinematic scene, explain the options, and ask before running the command.

output_examples.input: Generate a futuristic cityscape at sunset with flying cars.
output_examples.output: The skill runs the selected Gemini image app and returns generated image results for review and download.

output_examples.input: Create four minimalist logo directions for a coffee shop.
output_examples.output: The skill requests multiple image variations, making it easier to compare styles and choose a direction.

output_examples.input: Edit this landscape image by adding a rainbow in the sky.
output_examples.output: The skill submits the source image and edit instruction, then returns an updated image result.

best_practices: Review prompts, image URLs, and file inputs before running any infsh command.
Use Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for fast iteration and Gemini 3 Pro Image for final quality.
Avoid submitting sensitive images or regulated data unless the account and workflow are approved.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated commands without checking the model, account, and input data.
Do not use private image URLs unless sharing them with the remote service is acceptable.
Do not enable search grounding when a static or fictional image is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh CLI to run Google Gemini native image models.

faq.question: Does it support image editing?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows how to pass input image URLs with an edit prompt.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI must be installed and authenticated before generation commands can run.

faq.question: Can it create multiple images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented options include requesting multiple generated images.

faq.question: Should I use it with private images?
faq.answer: Only use private images when remote processing is approved for your data.
